title: Indian Market News Brief — 14 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Rising inflation in India and high crude oil prices may put pressure on the stock market. Strong export growth and a rally in heavyweight Reliance Industries provide support. Weakness in US technology stocks and upcoming large public share sales create a mixed picture.

stories.headline: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Markets snap 3-day rally; Sensex drops 318 points, Nifty slips below 25,150
stories.summary:
Retail inflation in India rose to 6.09 percent in October.
This rate crossed the central bank's target limit.
Government 10-year bond yields rose to 7.3079 percent.
Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty fell on Friday after a three-day rally.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: High inflation creates worries that the central bank might increase interest rates, which makes loans costlier for businesses.

stories.headline: अप्रैल-अक्टूबर 2026-27 के दौरान कुल निर्यात (वस्तु और सेवाएं) 568.84 बिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर होने का अनुमान है, जबकि अप्रैल-अक्टूबर 2025-26 में यह 487.59 बिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर था, यह 16.66 प्रतिशत की अनुमानित वृद्धि दर्शाता है
stories.summary:
India's total exports of goods and services reached 568.84 billion US dollars from April to October 2026.
This is higher than the 487.59 billion US dollars recorded in the same period last year.
This represents an estimated growth of 16.66 percent.
The figures were published in an official government release.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong growth in export earnings brings more revenue to Indian companies and supports the economy.

stories.headline: Rupee falls 8 paise to close at 94.20 against US dollar
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee fell by 8 paise to close at 94.20 against the US dollar.
During the day, the rupee traded between 94.05 and 94.28.
Rising global crude oil prices put pressure on the currency.
India's monthly trade deficit in goods reached its highest level of the year.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: A weaker rupee increases the cost of imported goods like crude oil, which can raise expenses for many industries.

stories.headline: Razorpay, Sembcorp Green Infra get Sebi nod to float IPOs
stories.summary:
Market regulator SEBI approved public share sale (IPO) plans for Razorpay and Sembcorp Green Infra.
Razorpay aims to raise 5,000 to 6,000 crore rupees to expand its business.
Sembcorp Green Infra plans to raise 3,750 crore rupees for renewable energy projects.
Both companies received official approval letters recently.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Large new share offerings attract fresh investor interest, but they can also pull cash away from existing market stocks.

stories.headline: Reliance Industries shares rebound 15% in November, add ₹2.38 lakh crore in market value; what's changed?
stories.summary:
Reliance Industries shares rebounded 15 percent during the month of November.
The company added 2.38 lakh crore rupees to its total market value.
The share price recovery followed strong second-quarter financial results.
Reliance is one of the largest stocks in the Nifty index.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Because Reliance carries a large weight in the index, a rise in its stock price directly pulls the Nifty higher.

stories.headline: Nifty PSU Bank logs biggest weekly surge in 7 months; PNB, Bank of India, Bank of Baroda among top performers
stories.summary:
Public sector bank stocks rallied for a third consecutive week.
The Nifty PSU Bank index climbed 8 percent to hit its highest level since March.
Punjab National Bank surged 13.3 percent to 143 rupees per share.
Bank of India and Bank of Baroda were also top gainers in the sector.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong gains in government bank shares boost overall investor confidence and lift the broader banking index.

stories.headline: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
stories.summary:
US technology stocks fell as shares of Nvidia dropped over 4 percent.
The Nasdaq index dropped 1.42 percent and the S&P 500 fell nearly 1 percent.
Investors cited worries over high technology stock valuations and inflation.
Softer producer inflation numbers failed to stop the market selloff.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Weakness in American technology shares often leads to cautious selling in Indian IT companies.

stories.headline: YES Bank files SC review plea over AT-1 bonds: What does it mean for investors after stock's 15% rebound?
stories.summary:
YES Bank filed a review petition in the Supreme Court of India.
The bank is challenging a court order regarding 8,415 crore rupees of AT-1 bonds.
The previous court ruling was against the bank writing down these bonds.
The bond issue directly impacts the bank's capital structure.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Resolution of this legal case will clear financial uncertainty for YES Bank, though the court outcome remains uncertain.
